actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident5 contributed over 30 units in the last round, so I punish them with the maximum severity my wallet allows and broadcast a reminder to keep contributions low.

message.reasoning:
We need to decide actions. Rule: observe last round contributions: round 4 contributions_by_agent shows Resident3 38.83, Resident5 114.14. Both >30. Any resident contributed more than 30 units in most recent round => punish that resident with max severity affordable. Wallet=38.48, punishment_cost=0.3, max severity = floor(wallet / cost)= floor(38.48/0.3)= floor(128.266)=128. Can punish one? Rule says "any other resident contributed more than 30 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with the maximum severity you can afford". Might need punish each? Probably punish each that qualifies, but can only one physical action per round. Choose one target. Could pick Resident5 (largest). Severity 128 will cost 128*0.9? Actually cost = severity * punishment_cost =128*0.3=38.4 which is within wallet 38.48, leaves ~0.08. So punish Resident5 with severity 128.

Also broadcast message discouraging large contributions.

Thus actions: punish Resident5 severity 128, broadcast message.

Explanation.
